findings.observed: MCU PD4 and two permissive gate inputs have no external fail-low bias.
findings.failure: A Hi-Z or open MCU output can leave the hardware permissive floating. Boolean false-injection tests do not establish the real open-circuit voltage.

findings.observed: Initial POST API accepts one scalar resistance, while protection/interface.json requires isolated per-branch measurements with uncertainty intervals.
findings.failure: A whole-pair or scalar check can authorize an attempt without proving both adopted25ohm resistors meet their individual limits.
findings.correction: Join two branch-specific measurements and uncertainty bounds to the boot/attempt-scoped POST. Align cold-admission and one-attempt policy with protection interface.
findings.verification: Two isolated branch uncertainty intervals, expiry and consumption tested with sanitizers.

findings.observed: TX command CRC is appended atbytes27/28 and computed over27bytes, copying the DOUT conversion-frame structure.
findings.failure: Once RX_CRC_EN is set, simplecommands expect CRC inword2; a single-registerWREG expectsCRC inword3. Current builder produces CRCerrors and rejected commands. WREG can execute despite CRCerror.
findings.correction: Separate simplecommand andWREG encoding; computeCRC over actual padded command/registerwords and putit immediately afterward, retaining full30byte clocks forconversionreadout. Add independent datasheet-vector tests.

findings.verification: Independent manufacturer DIN CRC vectors pass; actual target compile passes.

findings.observed: PD4 is configured and read as an input, but the circuit net CTRL_HEARTBEAT_OK is a supervisor-generated hardware permissive. PD3 receives the actual controller heartbeat.
findings.failure: The target cannot establish the hardware heartbeat qualification through the assigned pin. With no bias, the permissive can float.
findings.correction: Qualify fresh heartbeat edges on PD3; configure and drive PD4 as a fail-low output, including safe_outputs.
findings.verification: PD3 heartbeat input and fail-low PD4 output reviewed and Cortex-M0+ target compiled.

findings.observed: After a2ms acquisition pause, startup reads one frame before enabling DRDY interrupt handling. The ADC has a two-slot FIFO.
findings.failure: Unread stale data and the narrow DRDY pulse can misalign first acquisition timestamps or prevent predictable startup.
findings.correction: Use the documented SYNC sequence or two immediate frame reads after the pause; accept freshness only from post-synchronization conversions.
findings.verification: Two startup frame reads implemented and target compiled; actual FIFO timing remains physical validation.

findings.observed: Complementary low-side outputs use the dead-time inverter, but inhibit forces generator outputs to zero upstream of that inverter.
findings.failure: The forced zero can become a high low-side pad level. Therefore forcing all generators low does not establish four low external gate inputs, even in the disabled bench image.
findings.correction: Implement a checked shutdown downstream of inversion, or use a waveform topology with independently controllable safe pad levels. Preserve request-low first and cover initialization/partial initialization/fault paths.
findings.verification: Downstream GPIO-matrix disconnect and frozen shadow update verified against actual SDK registers; physical pad timing remains unmeasured.

findings.failure: The drilled hot plate and supplier flange do not share the specified mounting pattern; available clearance must not silently absorb a copied-dimension error.
findings.correction: Use the supplier45mm hole-center pitch and a declared mounting datum; keep8mm slot direction and5.4mm diameter distinct, then regenerate STEP, drilling coordinates and manifest.
findings.independent_verification: Four generated transverse pitches are45.0mm; test_mount_receipt.py rejects the former44.7mm geometry independently of the CAD generator. Full protection replay passes, with engineering holds preserved.
findings.remaining_limits: Nominal supplier drawing pattern only; edge datum/tolerances and installed interface/preload/thermal qualification remain unestablished. Supplier8mm slots now modeled separately from centred5.4mm plate drill holes.
